title: Goblin Scouts
description: Four goblin scouts at the forest edge in a week, always in pairs, always north to south. Coel Renn has no men to find what they are marking for. Kill what shows itself.

objectives.description: Kill the goblin scouts at the forest edge

notes: Threat: organized goblin scouting (paired, patterned movement) implies a column behind it the garrison cannot locate. Giver motive: Watch-Sergeant Renn can't spare men to track the column, so the bounty buys what reconnaissance it can. Refusal: the scouting continues unopposed and whatever is behind it closes the distance unwatched.
